items.original_question: Find section pairs that reference each other (checking for circular dependencies).
items.original_reference_query: MATCH (a:Section)-[:REFERENCES_SECTION]->(b:Section)-[:REFERENCES_SECTION]->(a) WHERE a.sectionId < b.sectionId MATCH (a)-[:BELONGS_TO_SPEC]->(sp1:Spec) MATCH (b)-[:BELONGS_TO_SPEC]->(sp2:Spec) RETURN sp1.specNumber + '-' + a.sectionNumber AS sectionA, sp2.specNumber + '-' + b.sectionNumber AS sectionB ORDER BY a.sectionId, b.sectionId LIMIT 20
items.task_question: Within the recorded RAN1 graph, return at most 20 distinct pairs of Section nodes with reciprocal direct REFERENCES_SECTION links. Use sectionIdA < sectionIdB to choose the endpoint roles, order pairs lexicographically by (sectionIdA,sectionIdB), and return sectionIdA, sectionIdB, sectionA and sectionB. sectionA and sectionB are each the endpoint specNumber followed by a hyphen and sectionNumber.
items.reference_query: MATCH (a:Section)-[:REFERENCES_SECTION]->(b:Section)-[:REFERENCES_SECTION]->(a) WHERE a.sectionId<b.sectionId MATCH (a)-[:BELONGS_TO_SPEC]->(sp1:Spec) MATCH (b)-[:BELONGS_TO_SPEC]->(sp2:Spec) RETURN DISTINCT a.sectionId AS sectionIdA,b.sectionId AS sectionIdB,sp1.specNumber+'-'+a.sectionNumber AS sectionA,sp2.specNumber+'-'+b.sectionNumber AS sectionB ORDER BY sectionIdA,sectionIdB LIMIT 20

source_audit.reason: Original asks section pairs but grades endpointA only and hides cap20. Variant explicitly defines finite extent, endpoint orientation and ordering; IDs distinguish stored release versions.

items.original_question: Which 10 CRs have the widest cross-spec reach, and which specs does each affect?
items.original_reference_query: MATCH (cr:CR)-[:AFFECTS_CORE_SPEC|AFFECTS_TEST_SPEC|AFFECTS_OM_SPEC]->(sp:Spec) RETURN cr.tdocNumber, count(DISTINCT sp) AS affectedSpecCount, collect(DISTINCT sp.specNumber) AS affectedSpecs ORDER BY affectedSpecCount DESC, cr.tdocNumber ASC LIMIT 10
items.task_question: Within the recorded RAN1 graph, return the 10 CR nodes with the largest number of distinct Spec nodes reached by AFFECTS_CORE_SPEC, AFFECTS_TEST_SPEC or AFFECTS_OM_SPEC. Return crNumber, affectedSpecCount and affectedSpecs. affectedSpecCount counts distinct Spec nodes; affectedSpecs is the lexicographically sorted list of distinct specNumber values. Choose exactly the first 10 by affectedSpecCount descending, then crNumber ascending, and return records in that order.
items.reference_query: MATCH (cr:CR)-[:AFFECTS_CORE_SPEC|AFFECTS_TEST_SPEC|AFFECTS_OM_SPEC]->(sp:Spec) WITH cr,count(DISTINCT sp) AS affectedSpecCount,collect(DISTINCT sp.specNumber) AS specs UNWIND specs AS specNumber WITH cr,affectedSpecCount,specNumber ORDER BY specNumber WITH cr,affectedSpecCount,collect(specNumber) AS affectedSpecs RETURN cr.tdocNumber AS crNumber,affectedSpecCount,affectedSpecs ORDER BY affectedSpecCount DESC,crNumber ASC LIMIT 10

required_fields.name: affectedSpecCount
required_fields.role: number of distinct affected Spec nodes

source_audit.reason: Original explicitly requests CR/spec mapping but key grades only CR ID. Define node-count versus spec-number distinction, exact10 boundary policy, ordering and canonical spec list; no graph-engine or causal effect claimed.

items.original_question: Return CR density (CRs per section) by spec (change-hotspot metric).
items.original_reference_query: MATCH (hub:Spec)<-[:MODIFIES]-(cr:CR) WHERE hub.specRelease IS NULL WITH hub, count(cr) AS crCnt MATCH (rk:Spec)-[:IN_RELEASE_OF]->(hub) WITH hub, crCnt, rk ORDER BY toInteger(replace(rk.specRelease,'Rel-','')) DESC WITH hub, crCnt, collect(rk)[0] AS latestRk MATCH (latestRk)<-[:BELONGS_TO_SPEC]-(s:Section) WITH hub, crCnt, count(s) AS secCnt RETURN hub.specNumber AS specNumber, crCnt, secCnt, round(1.0 * crCnt / secCnt, 2) AS density ORDER BY density DESC LIMIT 5
items.task_question: Within the recorded RAN2 graph, for every Spec hub whose specRelease is absent and which has at least one incoming CR MODIFIES link, count its distinct modifying CR nodes as crCnt. Choose its release-specific Spec node with the highest numeric Rel-N; break any equal release by id ascending. Count distinct Section nodes belonging to that release node as secCnt. For hubs with secCnt greater than zero, return specNumber, crCnt, secCnt and density=crCnt/secCnt rounded to two decimal places as an unordered set; no output cap.
items.reference_query: MATCH (hub:Spec)<-[:MODIFIES]-(cr:CR) WHERE hub.specRelease IS NULL WITH hub,count(DISTINCT cr) AS crCnt MATCH (rk:Spec)-[:IN_RELEASE_OF]->(hub) WITH hub,crCnt,rk ORDER BY toInteger(replace(rk.specRelease,'Rel-','')) DESC,rk.id ASC WITH hub,crCnt,collect(rk)[0] AS latestRk MATCH (latestRk)<-[:BELONGS_TO_SPEC]-(s:Section) WITH hub,crCnt,count(DISTINCT s) AS secCnt WHERE secCnt>0 RETURN hub.specNumber AS specNumber,crCnt,secCnt,round(1.0*crCnt/secCnt,2) AS density

required_fields.name: crCnt
required_fields.role: distinct CR numerator associated with the Spec hub

required_fields.name: secCnt
required_fields.role: distinct Section denominator of the selected release Spec node

required_fields.name: density
required_fields.role: CR numerator divided by Section denominator, rounded to two decimals

source_audit.reason: Original density leaves temporal population and denominator release unspecified. Variant states the source-defined numerator/denominator, deterministic release selection and no hidden cap5. Read-only probe found no multiple release nodes per hub/release in the current RAN2 graph, but this is not external source-truth certification.
source_audit.scope: explicit queryable records and documentary associations in the currently recorded WG graph; no causal or domain-expert truth claim

items.original_question: Return the granularity-property distribution across the five entity classes (item-level v3.0 vs section-level legacy).
items.original_reference_query: MATCH (n) WHERE any(l IN labels(n) WHERE l IN ['RRCParameter','CapabilityItem','Procedure','PerformanceRequirement','ConformanceTest']) RETURN [l IN labels(n) WHERE l IN ['RRCParameter','CapabilityItem','Procedure','PerformanceRequirement','ConformanceTest']][0] AS class,        coalesce(n.granularity, '<unset>') AS granularity,        count(n) AS c ORDER BY class, granularity
items.task_question: Within the recorded RAN2 graph, report counts for every present (class,granularity) combination over these node classes: RRCParameter, CapabilityItem, Procedure, PerformanceRequirement and ConformanceTest. A node contributes once for each listed class label it bears. Use <unset> when granularity is missing. Return class, granularity and count as an unordered set. Do not add zero-count combinations that are absent from the records.
items.reference_query: MATCH (n) UNWIND [l IN labels(n) WHERE l IN ['RRCParameter','CapabilityItem','Procedure','PerformanceRequirement','ConformanceTest']] AS class RETURN class,coalesce(n.granularity,'<unset>') AS granularity,count(n) AS count

required_fields.name: count
required_fields.role: number of nodes for this class/granularity pair

source_audit.reason: Original asks distribution; the key grades class alone and ignores granularity/count. The variant defines all five labels, missing-property treatment and per-class contribution instead of the original first-label selection.

Return exactly the first five (specNumber,crCnt) records ordered by crCnt descending, then specNumber ascending. crCnt is the distinct-CR count for that specNumber; this deterministic secondary key resolves boundary ties.
items.reference_query: MATCH (cr:CR)-[:TARGET_RELEASE]->(rel:Release {releaseName:'Rel-18'}), (cr)-[:MODIFIES]->(sp:Spec) RETURN sp.specNumber AS specNumber,count(DISTINCT cr) AS crCnt ORDER BY crCnt DESC,specNumber ASC LIMIT 5

required_fields.name: crCnt
required_fields.role: distinct Rel-18 CR count associated with that specification number

source_audit.reason: Original top5 explicitly sets extent but leaves boundary ties unstated, and scalar key cannot grade counts. Variant states count unit, both output roles and deterministic exact5 ordering.
source_audit.scope: explicit queryable records and documentary associations in the currently recorded WG graph; no causal or domain-expert truth claim

items.original_question: Show the distribution of figure counts per spec (figure-content profile).
items.original_reference_query: MATCH (f:TSFigure)-[:FIGURE_IN_SECTION]->(s:Section)-[:BELONGS_TO_SPEC]->(sp:Spec) RETURN sp.specNumber, count(f) AS figCnt ORDER BY figCnt DESC LIMIT 5
items.task_question: Within the recorded RAN3 graph, for every specNumber reached from at least one TSFigure through FIGURE_IN_SECTION then BELONGS_TO_SPEC, count distinct TSFigure nodes. Return specNumber and figCnt as an unordered set; no output cap. Specs with no such recorded TSFigure path are outside this formal task population.
items.reference_query: MATCH (f:TSFigure)-[:FIGURE_IN_SECTION]->(s:Section)-[:BELONGS_TO_SPEC]->(sp:Spec) RETURN sp.specNumber AS specNumber,count(DISTINCT f) AS figCnt

required_fields.name: specNumber
required_fields.role: specification number with recorded figure paths

required_fields.name: figCnt
required_fields.role: number of distinct TSFigure nodes associated with this specification number

source_audit.reason: Original distribution has unstated cap5 and grades spec IDs alone. Variant restores count output, states observed-path population and avoids inventing zero counts for unrepresented specs.
source_audit.scope: explicit queryable records and documentary associations in the currently recorded WG graph; no causal or domain-expert truth claim

items.original_question: List the change reasons of CRs modifying section 9.4.5 of spec 38.473 (section-level change rationale).
items.original_reference_query: MATCH (sec:Section {sectionNumber: '9.4.5'})-[:BELONGS_TO_SPEC]->(sp:Spec {specNumber: '38.473'}) MATCH (sec)<-[:MODIFIES_SECTION]-(c:CR) RETURN c.tdocNumber AS tdocNumber, c.reasonForChange AS reason ORDER BY toInteger(replace(sp.specRelease,'Rel-','')) DESC, c.tdocNumber DESC LIMIT 10
items.task_question: Within the recorded RAN3 graph, return every distinct (tdocNumber,reason) record for a CR linked by MODIFIES_SECTION to a Section numbered 9.4.5 belonging to spec 38.473, across stored release versions. reason is that CR node's reasonForChange value; return null if the property is absent. Return an unordered set; no output cap.
items.reference_query: MATCH (sec:Section {sectionNumber:'9.4.5'})-[:BELONGS_TO_SPEC]->(sp:Spec {specNumber:'38.473'}) MATCH (sec)<-[:MODIFIES_SECTION]-(c:CR) RETURN DISTINCT c.tdocNumber AS tdocNumber,c.reasonForChange AS reason

required_fields.name: tdocNumber
required_fields.role: CR identifier for the requested Section association

source_audit.reason: Original asks change reasons but key grades CR identifiers only. Variant explicitly defines CR/reason pairs, all stored versions, null absence treatment and no hidden cap10.

items.original_question: Return the Rel-17-targeted TRs with their spec-impact types (release study impact map).
items.original_reference_query:
MATCH (tr:TechnicalReport)-[:TARGET_RELEASE]->(r:Release {releaseName: 'Rel-17'})
                  OPTIONAL MATCH (tr)-[:HAS_TR_IMPACT]->(imp:TRImpact)-[:IMPACTS_SPEC]->(s:Spec)
                  RETURN tr.trNumber, tr.trTitle, collect({spec: s.specNumber, type: imp.impactType}) AS impacts
items.task_question: Within the recorded RAN3 graph, return every distinct (trNumber,specNumber,impactType) record where a TechnicalReport targets Rel-17 and is linked through HAS_TR_IMPACT then IMPACTS_SPEC to a Spec. Return an unordered set. This population includes reports with an actual recorded spec-impact link; no causal or external semantic certification is claimed.
items.reference_query: MATCH (tr:TechnicalReport)-[:TARGET_RELEASE]->(r:Release {releaseName:'Rel-17'}), (tr)-[:HAS_TR_IMPACT]->(imp:TRImpact)-[:IMPACTS_SPEC]->(s:Spec) RETURN DISTINCT tr.trNumber AS trNumber,s.specNumber AS specNumber,imp.impactType AS impactType

required_fields.name: trNumber
required_fields.role: TechnicalReport identity targeting the scoped release

required_fields.name: specNumber
required_fields.role: Specification associated with this report impact

required_fields.name: impactType
required_fields.role: Recorded type of this report/spec impact

source_audit.reason: Original requires TR/spec-impact mapping while key grades TR ID only. Flatten the stored repeated impact objects into distinct named triples; the variant explicitly excludes reports without a spec-impact edge instead of silently certifying optional-null semantics.
